player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

round.announce:
### Tûngûla {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Kârtî ô la rivâle âzî: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Supply exactly ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Mo lingbi pëpe [check] - mo yeke na gbele mbeni pari.
invalid_move.amount_min: A lingbi kota ti nginza so a zia na yâ ni aduti 1 wala ahon tongaso.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Mbeni ye ti iri na lo ayeke dä pëpe; mo lingbi [check] ni.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Use [bet X] to open; there is no bet to raise.
invalid_move.insufficient: A yeke wara gbâ ti azo tongaso pëpe.

board.possible_actions: Aye so mo lingbi ti sara: {legal}

message.folded: Zo ti pikango ndembo ni {player_id} azia.
message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: both {card}. Pot split – each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: A lingbi tere na peko ti angbonga ni kue.
